📖 How to use

  1. Enter the original date of the anniversary.
  2. See instantly how many days remain until the next one.
  3. Read which anniversary number it is, with the correct ordinal (1st, 2nd, 3rd…).
  4. Check total days elapsed and the weekday of the next celebration.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which anniversary number is it?

The count of full years completed. If you married in 2016 and the next anniversary is in 2026, that is your 10th anniversary.

What happens with Feb 29 anniversaries?

In non-leap years the anniversary is observed on Feb 28, and the tool notes this. In leap years it falls on Feb 29 itself.

Can I use it for non-wedding anniversaries?

Yes — work anniversaries, sobriety dates, founding dates: any annual milestone works the same way.
